name: Communion
summary: After getting divorced, Au Yiu-cho and Tang Lai-kuen operate two restaurants coincidentally called Yuet Tak House in Hong Kong and on the mainland respectively. They never have issues with each other. In 2022, Lai-kuen abruptly returns to Hong Kong to open a branch. She declares she wants to obtain the rights to the Yuet Tak House trademark through legal channels. The duo's little son Au Ka-kin signs up for Greater Bay Area Youth Entrepreneurship Competition. He runs into his elder brother Au Ka-him, who is appointed as an instructor, and also fellow competitor Cheung Loi. However, they familiarize with each other through conflict and strife, and they team up to create metaverse Yuet Tak House. Yuet Tak House physical store and its metaverse equivalent are both sued for copyright infringement, and Yiu-cho, Lai-kuen, Ka-kin and Ka-him face different hurdles. After all, they are related family members, so are they able to restore the initial bliss and tenderness to their relationship?

name: Redbad - The Legend
summary: In the year of 754 AD, the legend of the pagan warrior king, Redbad, is born, but so is a new weapon against his people: Christianity. Redbad must ultimately unite a Viking army powerful enough to defeat the seemingly invincible Franks

name: Team Zenko Go
summary: No good deed is too small for this kind kid squad! Niah, Ari, Ellie and Jax go undercover to help others and squash their town's problems in secret!

previousepisode.name: That Stinking Feeling / Go for the Gold

name: Chad and JT Go Deep
summary: Stoke Lords, Chad Kroeger and JT Parr, take their activism to the streets of Southern California to spread awareness on important issues. But when one of their causes accidentally leads to their cancellation, they use their activism to win back the good graces and trust of the culture.

name: Iyanu
summary: Drawing on Nigerian culture, music, and mythology, the animated series follows Iyanu, a brave young orphan living in the magical kingdom of Yorubaland. While studying history and ancient arts, she yearns for a normal life—until a looming threat awakens divine powers not seen since the legendary Age of Wonders. Accompanied by newfound friends Biyi, Toye, and a magical leopard named Ekun, Iyanu sets out to uncover the source of this evil, unlocking her destiny along the way.

previousepisode.name: Iyanu: The War of Twin Princes

name: Seyyar
summary: Yasin Gencer is a modest peddler who sells chickpeas and rice between Taksim and Tepebaşı. He lives with his lover Çiğdem, on the verge of opening the restaurant, they have been planning for a long time, and is at the very end of marketing his rice, which everyone loves to taste, with a special recipe heirloom from his family to wider masses and reaching their dreams. But in a way that befits Beyoğlu, one night after another, everything turns upside down. Unexpectedly, Yasin will find himself side by side with the darkest figures of Istanbul.

name: Руслан и Людмила
summary: Доблестный Руслан, отправившийся на поиски похищенной невесты, одолевает коварство, обман, злое колдовство - и, в конце концов, в жестоком бою побеждает Черномора...

name: Koi Nante, Honki de Yatte Dousuruno?
summary: 27-year-old romance-free girl VS. Seta romance boy. Stability-oriented early marriage less wife VS. In translation mysterious chef. Beloved and addicted Papa Katsu Girls VS. Mysterious Yin-Yang Boys. A group image love story woven by 6 men and women who "can't get serious about love"!

name: Dirty Laundry
summary: Host Lily Du gathers together four guests to tell secrets, guess who they belong to, and enjoy a few drinks.

previousepisode.name: Who Joined an Ex on Their Honeymoon?

name: We the People with Judge Lauren Lake
summary: We the People with Judge Lauren Lake is a daily/strip one-hour syndicated court series.

previousepisode.name: Stella Got Evicted & Scoot, There It Is!

name: Breaking News: No Laugh Newsroom
summary: In this newsroom, breaking means losing. Our reporters don't know what's about to be on the teleprompter, and every laugh is a point against them.

name: Joe and Katherine's Bargain Holidays
summary: Bargain-blagger Joe Wilkinson and luxury-lover Katherine Ryan show us how to live the champagne lifestyle on a lemonade budget with some fantastically affordable getaways.

name: Platform 7
summary: Platform 7 follows Lisa who, after witnessing a cataclysmic event on platform 7 of a railway station, finds her own fragmented memory jogged to reveal a connection between her own life and that of the event she has just witnessed.

name: Women Who Rock
summary: A docuseries that pays homage to female pioneers in music who have stormed the stage, wielded their instruments, amplified their voices, and sung the soundtrack of our lives. In their own words, generations of iconic female artists discuss truth, defiance, artistic expression, hard-won success, and most importantly, the insights and tales behind their timeless music. The series features original interviews with Nancy Wilson, Shania Twain, Chaka Khan, Pat Benatar, Mavis Staples, Sheryl Crow, Sheila E., Macy Gray, Rickie Lee Jones, Norah Jones, Aimee Mann, Tori Amos, Kate Pierson, Tina Weymouth, St. Vincent, Jody Watley, and Nona Hendryx.

name: WWII Battles in Color
summary: World War II was marked by epic battles that decided the fate of nations and changed the course of history. From Germany's Blitzkrieg attacks on France, which launched the European campaign, to the Allied invasion of Berlin, which signaled its violent end, we bring these seminal conflicts to life through never-before-seen colorized combat footage. WWII Battles in Color puts you in the center of the action through rarely-scene films from the frontline, plus personal memoirs and oral histories from both sides of the battle lines.

name: Chicken Girls: College Years
summary: Rooney joins a sorority and meets a girl while at college.

previousepisode.name: The End or a New Beginning?

name: Anonymously Yours
summary: Welcome to Anonymously Yours, hosted by Teala Dunn! You've sent in your juiciest confessions, and each week Teala and a guest are going to read them, give advice, and dish on some of their own confessions.

name: Interview with My Kid | the Podcast
summary: Interview with My Kid is a brand new vodcast hosted by trans dad, Jesse Sullivan, and his 13 year-old nonbinary child, Arlo. Tune in each week as this father-kid duo welcomes a new guest for an open dialogue around issues like identity, pronouns, acceptance, and Gen Z vs. Millennial viewpoints.

name: High School Musical
summary: East High is taken by storm when Troy, the star captain of the school's basketball team, and Gabriella, a brainy new student, connect on a level that's more than a school crush.

name: 8.2 Byo no Hosoku
summary: About Amai Koichi who is good at baking and making sweets trying to help ikemens (good looking, handsome guys). If two people look into each other eyes for 8.2 seconds they will fall in love. Amai is attracted to men as he looks at them and falls for them. Each love interest per episode has a problem so Amai makes sweets/deserts for them in hopes to help them.

name: Kick, Raoul, la moto, les jeunes et les autres
summary: The adventures of a group of young motorcycle enthusiasts from a small village in the Ardèche.

name: L'Amour est aveugle
summary: Between six and eight people (at the start of the show 3 men and 3 women, then 1 man and 1 woman arrive during the show, then two eliminated), who have never met will have to get to know each other and why not to find love in a rather original way: in the dark.

name: Les Papillons Noirs
summary: Adrien is a 40 years old writer known as Mody who only wrote one successful novel and has been facing blank page syndrome ever since. He now is a ghost writer and has recently been hired by Albert, an old man dying from an uncurable disease and who will tell him everything about his life.

name: Enquête de santé
summary: The show explores in depth a specific public health theme linked to current events. It broadcasts a documentary followed by patient testimonies and a debate with several specialists.

name: Platonique
summary: Unhappy as a couple, Yann and Elsa leave their respective spouses to establish a friendship and be roomies. With their respective children who arrive every other week Yann and Elsa hope to find the perfect balance.

name: Random Passage
summary: Follows a courageous woman's journey from servitude in England to the harsh life of Outport Newfoundland. Along the way she endures many hardships, including attempted rape and being abandoned by the father of her child.

name: Gérard de par le monde - Le Japon
summary: In this mini documentary series, Gérard Depardieu invites us to discover the culture of the art of living in the land of the Rising Sun.

name: Notre-Dame, la part du feu
summary: The series takes place during the night that Notre-Dame burned. It's about the destiny of men and women who have their own fire to put out. As the Paris firefighters try to stop the flames from spreading in the Cathedral, the show also follows characters being put through the wringer - they will have to fight each other, love each other, come across each other, hate each other, smile at or help each other - so that, in the end, they may have a chance to start all over again.

name: Vortex
summary: 2025. Captain of the judicial police in Brest, Ludovic lost the love of his life, Mélanie, 27 years ago. The mother of their daughter Juliette died in what appeared to be an accident… But suddenly, thanks to a time rift that opens inside a reconstructed crime scene in virtual reality, they can communicate between 1998 and 2025! Ludovic warns Mélanie: she will die in 11 days! But saving her from certain death means that Ludovic risks losing his life in the present, the one he took so long to rebuild: his new wife, Parvana and their son Sam...

previousepisode.name: Gil Alma, Anggun, Virginie Hocq et Titoff

name: Les Disparus de la Forêt-Noire
summary: A mass grave is discovered on the Franco-German border. Investigating judge Camille Hartmann has lost her memory since an accident, but she feels that the murders are linked to her past. Erik Maes asks him to help him in his investigation...

name: That's My Jam
summary: With a whole host of celebrity guests, dance and trivia-based games, and unforgettable musical performances, That's My Jam promises to take popular and well known songs to the next level like never before.

previousepisode.name: Chrishell Stause, Mary Fitzgerald, Lucy Davis, David Koechner

name: Wielka woda
summary: Set during the flood of the millennium which hit Wrocław and its surroundings in 1997. When a flood wave approaches the capital of Lower Silesia, a decision is made - in order to save the city from the destructive element, the surrounding villages and fields have to be sacrificed. How will one decision affect the life of an entire community? The three main characters, faced with an extreme situation, will face events which will result in enormous destruction and the death of innocent people.

name: 180 Degree Longitude Passes Through Us
summary: Sasiwimol is an extremely successful director. She has a close, friend-like relationship with her teenage son Wang. What will she do when Wang experiences his first love with Inthawut, her old friend? Love, relationships, understanding, mother and son learning from each other in this era of changeability. A friendship will forever be altered.

name: Je ne suis pas un robot
Diane de Poitiers, la plus que reine
summary: For more than twenty years, Diane de Poitiers was King Henri II's favorite. Despite her strong character and her legendary beauty, Diane is just another courtesan and her position remains fragile. And Henri's upcoming marriage to Catherine de Medici may jeopardize her dreams of domination. Diane will do anything to maintain her influence. But can her passion with Henri, twenty years younger than her, which is key to her power, really last forever?

name: NYC Revealed
summary: From garbage trucks to power plants, giving viewers a rare behind-the-scenes look into the sprawling network of infrastructure systems that keep New York City breathing.

name: Shaun Micallef's Brain Eisteddfod
summary: Shaun Micallef's Brain Eisteddfod will feature teams of three year eleven students from schools across Australia to find the brightest of the bunch. Teams will have to show off their range of knowledge in a handful of categories like maths, art, foreign languages, music, all things Australiana and more.

name: Billion Dollar Holiday City
summary: Behind the scenes of Las Vegas, the city in the Nevada desert that is famed for its gambling, showgirls and all-night parties. Featuring characters and stories that make Las Vegas one of the most hedonistic and fun-filled cities on earth, with access to casinos, wedding chapels, police and performers.

name: Help! We Bought a Village
summary: British people rebuilding abandoned historic settlements in Europe.

name: Best in Dough
summary: In a world where there seems to be little agreement on anything, there is one great unifier... the universal love of pizza. Best in Dough brings together pizza obsessed competitors from all walks of life to showcase their pizza slinging skills and battle it out for a cash prize. Fire up the oven, the first ever pizza competition is on!

name: Los Farad
summary: Los Farad will introduce the audience to the Marbella of the 1980s through Oskar, a boy with dreams of opening up a gym and who, with the help of Sara Farad, ends up getting mixed with the fascinating world of the Costa del Sol, its jetsetting lifestyle, eccentricities, and geopolitics. This new world opens up to him thanks to the Farads, a family that offers him a future, but with the most unexpected of trades: arms trafficking.

name: Victoria's Secret: Angels and Demons
summary: Truth is not what it seems; as the underworld of fashion, the billionaire class, and Jeffrey Epstein are revealed to all be inextricably intertwined with the rise and fall of this legendary brand.

name: Riptide
summary: Riptide follows Alison, whose life is plunged into despair when her new Australian husband vanishes after a morning surf. It quickly becomes obvious there is more to the story than meets the eye as she sets out to investigate his disappearance.

name: His Man
summary: As South Korea's very first gay dating reality series, His Man brings together a group of eight hot, sexy, free and single gay men to a shared house where they are to live, interact and open up to each other in their quest for "true love".

name: Merry Queer
summary: Merry Queer features the stories of queer couples on their "coming out" journeys, whether it be revealing their "unconventional" relationships to families, friends, or the world.

name: Stevens & McCarthy
summary: Fast-paced, action packed sketch comedy with Louise McCarthy and Gayle Telfer Stevens.

name: Animalia
summary: A group of Argentine documentarians spent three weeks in a natural park with no connection to civilization. When they return, they find that an epidemic has broken out around them, turning people into wild zombies.

name: Gadis Kretek
summary: A son's journey to find a woman from his father's past unearths a tapestry of secrets — and the untold history of their family's clove cigarette dynasty.

name: League of Nations Air Force Aviation Magic Band Luminous Witches
summary: The war against invading aliens can't be won by missiles alone! Team morale matters just as much as launching a counterassault, and that's where Ginny and her friends come in. Instead of standing on the front lines with the 501st Joint Fighter Wing, the Luminous Witches of the League of Nations Air Force bring smiles to civilians displaced in the human-Neuroi war world with thrilling song and dance — not to mention aerial displays the likes of which the music world has never seen! While they might be non-combatants, these performers know the value of preserving the people's smiles, and they'll fight in their unique way to make sure those smiles never fade.

name: Takara-kun & Amagi-kun
summary: Takara belongs to the most prominent group in his class and is highly popular with the others, while Amagi is more quiet but is still bright, energetic and generally well-liked. Although they are classmates, the boys have no direct interaction with each other due to the differences in their peer groups, but in fact, both have surreptitiously become interested in the other. Realizing that their attraction may be love, Takara and Amagi decide to secretly date together without telling anyone else. However, Amagi, who is confused by Takara's mysterious lack of words and actions, is pushed to make an important decision.

name: Chimimo
summary: The "heart-warming comedy" anime centers on Chimimo, who is a messenger of hell and a shape-shifting evil demon. Chimimo is one of 12 evil demons whose mission is to turn the human world into hell. The 12 demons along with "Hell-san" go to the human world, but Hell-san and Chimimo become freeloaders to a family of three sisters named Mutsumi, Hazuki, and Mei.

previousepisode.name: Creating Hell! And Then Into the Hellfire... / A Hellish Ending

name: You Light Up My Life Again
summary: In this university, there is a collective activity called BUDDYHERE that has been held for four years. It lasts for one semester and involves an appointed Budder who must take care of their assigned Buddy. The Budder are aware of who their Buddy is but not vice versa. The Buddy can even rate and guess the identity of their Budder. If guessed correctly, the Buddy gains the right to having the Budder care for them for the entire semester.

name: The Prince of Tennis II: U-17 World Cup
summary: The story follows the unfolding of the U-17 World Cup, which takes place at the KCC Arena, in Melbourne, Australia. A total of 32 countries are participating in this long-awaited competition, and only 16 of them will manage to qualify for the final stages...

name: Cold Case Geschichte
summary:
"Cold Case History" examines major murder cases in history and retells them as historical crime stories. Hundreds, even thousands of years later, these unsolved cases are being reopened using modern forensic technology.

The exciting series takes viewers into worlds long gone. Each case takes them back to the time when the crime was committed. From there, a gripping criminal case unfolds. All relevant theories and clues about the case are presented; some of them turn out to be false leads - in the classic crime tradition. Experts and scientists reveal the twists and turns of the case step by step and make surprising discoveries along the way.

previousepisode.name: Death of the Noble Whore - Rosemarie Nitribitt

name: Rilakkuma's Theme Park Adventure
summary: Rilakkuma, Korilakkuma, Kiiroitori, and Kaoru are off on an adventure to the theme park, but with closing time imminent it leads to a series of fun mishaps and incidents as the group squeeze a day of fun into tiny amount of time.

name: Jiu Tian Xuan Di Jue
summary:
Of all the races in the world only 3 stand at the top. Each race possesses a master of the martial arts, a Golden Martial God. The balance of power appears to be shifting after Wang Fan's brother is killed triggering a chain of events that will begin to turn the world upside down. Disguising himself as the Silver Tiger King, Wang Fan becomes a symbol of power and the hope of the human race.
Some days Wang Fan is a boy genius that tries to blend in as a smart but helpless student. Other days he becomes a powerful tiger. Every race has their eyes on the Silver Tiger King as he continues to surpass every precedent and excel far beyond his peers all while under the guise of an unassuming student.

name: Jack the Ripper: 5 Victims
summary: Experts investigate the crimes of Jack the Ripper by starting with victim Mary Ann 'Polly' Nichols, a casualty of Victorian prejudices as much as the killer

name: Shoorveer
summary: When an imminent attack threatens India, an elite unit undertakes a mission that will test the limits of their courage and grit.

name: Dreamland
summary:
Dreamland is about secrets, lies, loves and aspirations within a family of four sisters. Set in the sun-drenched British seaside town of Margate, it is a dark comedic exploration of multi-generational female relationships, and their (somewhat dysfunctional) family dynamics.

Eldest sister Trish is pregnant for the third time with her partner Spence. And this time, she's decided: it's going to be a girl. Her two sisters Clare and Leila rally around her with their mum and their Margate- legend nan, "manifesting" a little girl at Trish's ‘mani-festival'. But when their other sister, Mel, makes an unexpected reappearance back into their lives, her return threatens to destabilise the entire family. A knock on their door and their ‘Dreamland' is no more...

name: Tira
summary: Santiago Quiñones, a civil police officer has to solve two complicated cases; the emergence of a radicalized xenophobic group and, the murder of a drug dealer of Chinese origin, however, the most difficult case to solve is his own life.

name: If You Wish Upon Me
summary: The story of patients and the caregivers of a hospice department. It is the story of people who dream of 'well-dying'.

name: Hunted
summary: A mystery thriller that happened in an ordinary village in which a missing case occurs on the day of a wild boar hunting and the secrets of the villagers surrounding the case are being unfolded one by one.

name: Little Women
summary: Little Women is a work that depicts the story of three sisters who have good friendship.

name: The Law Cafe
summary:
A work that deals with the story of a former prosecutor-turned-building owner who used to be called a monstrous genius and a former Miss Korea turned lawyer, surrounding the law office and 'law café'.

Adapted from the web novel "Love According to Law" (법대로 사랑하라) written by No Seung Ah (노승아) and illustrated by Il Ri (일리).

name: The First Responders
summary: A joint response field log between the police who catch criminals and firefighters who catch fires. The police station and the fire station jointly respond to fierce scenes between crime, disasters and emergencies.

name: The Empire of Law
summary: A drama that depicts scandalous scandals of the nation's top law-abiding aristocrats dreaming of hereditary succession.

name: Tonight at the Games
summary: Highlights from all the action at the 2022 Commonwealth games in Birmingham.

name: Stock Struck
summary:
A comedy drama about five investors who are called "ants" in Korea.
These are ordinary people, unrelated to each other, who meet in a mysterious investment club, learn life, friendship and love by playing on the stock exchange.

name: A Model Family
summary: After unwittingly stealing money from a cartel, a cash-strapped professor finds the only way to save his broken family is by working as a drug courier.

name: Binary Love
summary:
Zhou Lin Lin is one of those students who do well in some subjects, but fail with others. Thanks to a thorough curriculum compiled for her by the excellent student Fan Yu Ke, Lin Lin not only manages to catch up, but also to enroll in the best university in the country.
It would seem that after the entrance exams, the paths of Zhou Lin Lin and Wang Yu Ke will diverge, but unexpectedly they were accepted to the same specialty at the university. The story of their relationship continues.
Based on Po Po's novel "Peking University Students".

name: Dear Probationary Girlfriend
summary:
This is an inspiring story about Lin Zi Yan, who became sensitive and lonely after his eyes were damaged, and Xia Yu, a bright and positive girl who was his housekeeper. They healed each other and grew up together.

Lin Ziyang was pessimistic and withdrawn due to eye disease, gradually regained his passion for life and career, as he was influenced by Xia Yu's optimistic attitude.

Xia Yu, despite the difficult relationship with her family, was always dynamic in the face of life's difficulties. There is no life-long probation period, so we shouldn't limit our options, she thought.

name: Hanayome Miman Escape
summary: Kashiwazaki Yu has been dating her boyfriend Naoki for 7 years, and they have been living together for 5 of them. Romance has long gone out of the relationship and even Yu Naoki's birthday is more interested in his new game than her holiday. And Naoki doesn't seem to be thinking about the wedding at all. An angry Yu leaves the house and immediately meets her ex-boyfriend from Fukami High School. Yu finds himself in a love triangle. What will the girl choose — the current guy who treats her more like a mother, or the former, who still has tender feelings for her and considers her special?

name: Yukionna to Kani wo Kuu
summary: One summer day, a young man, Kita (Shigeoka Milking), who has no money and nowhere to live, tried to commit suicide, but could not take the last step. Hesitating between life and death, he saw a program about gourmet food on TV, and realizing that he had never eaten crabs in his life, he decided that "on my last day on this Earth, I will eat crabs." However, China needs money to implement its plan. After following a woman Yukieda Ayame (Iriyama Noriko), who lives in a prestigious area, he made his way to her house and demanded money, however ... everything did not go according to plan.

name: The Trick of Life and Love
summary:
When you rescue the man who annoyed you the most and he wakes up with amnesia, what kind of relationship can you expect?
Overbearing CEO Ningcheng Ming has a reputation as a "professor from hell". After a mysterious car accident, he was saved by Li Qian, whom he had not seen for many years. They were enemies. Once she was a witty student, and now she is a versatile secretary.

name: Big Food Bucket List
summary: Host John Catucci (You Gotta Eat Here!) takes viewers on a one-of-a-kind food adventure across North America as he checks buzz-worthy, crazy, delicious food off his bucket list. In each episode, John visits the restaurants behind these must-eat meals and hits the kitchen to lend a helping hand and learn how the chefs make their mind-blowing creations. We're talking sticky, saucy Missouri-style ribs, Nova Scotia's straight from the sea, succulent lobster, Vancouver B.C.'s crispy, out of this world fried chicken, and Irvine, Calf.'s overloaded spaghetti grilled cheese you have to see to believe. John's setting out to eat each and every drool-worthy dish, and check them off his Big Food Bucket List.

name: Love in Contract
summary:
A drama about single life helpers who become wives to single men who need wives to attend meetings.

Tells the story of a helper service that provides wives to single people needing partners to take to gatherings for married couples and school reunions. The story portrays Choi Sang Eun as she gets entangled with Jung Ji Ho, who is on a long-term exclusive contract for Mondays, Wednesdays, and Fridays, and Kang Hae Jin, who signs a new contract for Tuesdays, Thursdays, and Saturdays. Choi Sang Eun, is a woman possessing many great qualities and virtues. As the perfect partner, she chooses a career of helping single men who don't want to get married instead of getting married herself. Jung Ji Ho who has been in a long-term contract with Choi Sang Eun for Mondays, Wednesdays, and Fridays for his fifth year. In addition for the reason behind his contract being a secret, Jung Ji Ho is a mysterious character whose occupation, hobbies, and personality are also shrouded in a veil of secrecy. And Kang Hae Jin, a rich heir as the family's youngest son and Hallyu star. Kang Hae Jin is Choi Sang Eun's newest client for Tuesdays, Thursdays, and Saturdays, and he will cause a great storm in her heart.

name: Talk Ville
summary: It was only a matter of time - Join costars Tom Welling (Clark Kent) and Michael Rosenbaum (Lex Luthor) as they dissect a new episode every week from one of the greatest shows of all time, Smallville.

name: Three Siblings Bravely
summary: A story about K-first daughter Kim Tae-joo and top star K-first son Lee Sang-joon seeking happiness.

name: Mental Coach Je Gal Gil
summary:
A sports drama about a former national athlete who quit sports after an accident helps players in the slumps, heal retired old veterans and plays a real game against the absurd world of winner-take-all.

A sports drama about a former national athlete who quits sports after causing a scandal and becomes a mental coach to help former professional athletes who have retired and current athletes who have fallen into a slump. Je Gal Gil is a former national Taekwondo athlete who is known for his hard work and dorky charms. After he causes an unprecedented accident in the athlete's village, Je Gal Gil is permanently expelled and coined the unlucky Taekwondo prodigy. Once he overcomes his past trauma and regains his mental health, Je Gal Gil returns to the athlete's village as a mental coach. Cha Ga Eul is a former world-class short track speed skating gold medalist who has fallen into a slump. With her pretty poker face, she's known as the up-and-coming "Ice Princess," but she faces the danger of fading out when she falls into a slump. Unable to confide in anyone, Cha Ga Eul begins to beat herself up until she meets mental coach Je Gal Gil. Gu Tae Man is the director of the Human Rights Center in the Korean Olympic Committee. The former Taekwondo Olympic gold medalist has a strong desire for power and is the reason Je Gal Gil's life was transformed overnight. With the belief that anything can be covered as long as he is No. 1, Gu Tae Min does everything he can for the top position. Park Seung Ha is a part of the mental health support team in the athlete's village. She is the perfect example of "a kind daughter who was raised well" but endures an unexpected hardship after meeting Je Gal Gil as her first patient. Park Seung Ha ends up leaving the hospital and applying to the athlete's village instead where she surprisingly reunites with Je Gal Gil, this time as advisor partners.

name: Crazy Bitches
summary: After the slaughter at Great Spirits ranch one or more killers remains on the loose, unbeknownst to a gathering of women at The Wellness Retreat and healing Spa Ranch in Big Sur. A private and secluded spa in the mountains along the coast of California, TWRHSR, as it is affectionately known, is an gathering place where small groups of women (and their GBFs) of all ages and ilks gather to reclaim their relationship with mother earth and their own vaginas. A new group of arrivals enjoy a beautiful first day in the sun before things turn dark with a storm of epic proportions. The storm causes the only bridge out of town to collapse and the communications to be short-circuited. which would not have given anyone pause if it hadn't been for the dead body in the hot tub. While the first body could easily have been an accident, the second sends off warning bells in staff and guest alike. But no one can leave and help can't come until communication is restored and the bridge out of town is repaired. It will be a long 5 days and the body count will rise until help arrives to save those that remain.

name: To Be a Brave One
summary: This is a story about a young, promising woman An Yu, the chairman of Haowu Group. She had everything a young woman could dream of: a happy family and a career. But a car accident ruined everything. She was in a coma for two years. After coming out of a coma, she found out about the betrayal of a loved one. Recovering from the shock, Han Yu decided to go to work to calm the pain. She accidentally meets Shao Mo Li. After getting acquainted with Han Yu's business and her ideas, the young man decided to help her and jointly engage in this business. After going through all the difficulties, they managed to bring their mutual business to the highest level. Working together helped them not only to get closer, but also to fall in love with each other.

name: Yunikon ni Notte
summary:
When Sana was only 23 years old on her sleeve, she co-founded the startup Dream Pony. The main product of the company was an educational application, and Sana dreamed that her application would become popular all over the world. Now the girl is already 26, and her startup has been around for three years. At first, things were going very well, but now the company is in stagnation. Because of this, the sleeves are constantly worried. In addition, she was trapped in unrequited love because of her feelings for Suzuki Ko, the co-founder of Dream Pony, who knows nothing about the feelings of his colleague.
One day, a middle-aged man who is Satoshi gets a job at Dream Pony. Before that, who worked in a traditional Japanese company, and it's hard for him to get used to the "modern" way of doing business. And on the sleeves, in whose subordination the man turned out to be, I am not happy with such cooperation. However, it soon became clear that Kotori could share his knowledge based on wisdom and experience.

name: Santa Evita
summary: The sometimes near surreal and always significant fate of Eva Perón's body after her death in 1952 as it awaited burial for decades.

name: Palacios Los Gansos
summary: An eccentric bipolar young woman hires a false therapeutic companion who will try to help her through her emotional instability, looking for creative and somewhat crazy solutions.

name: Master's Delicacies
summary: The story is about a romance between Chu Ah Ran, who has a mokpan blog, but in fact she is not interested in food, and chef Ah N S Ulha.

name: Охотники за привидениями
summary: A mystical program whose presenters help ordinary people understand paranormal phenomena. Pavel Yarygin and Sofya Ignatova engage professional practicing psychics to investigate cases of anomalies occurring in real life.

name: Indian Predator: The Butcher of Delhi
summary: A series of mutilated bodies and taunting notes left outside a Delhi jail sends police hunting for a seasoned killer with a grudge against the system.

name: Papás por Encargo
summary: California receives an unexpected gift: her mother, Itzel, has sent her a van together with a request: she wants her to travel to Zacatecas to be reunited with her after a nine-year absence. California convinces her three mistrustful parents that this trip will lead them to happiness. Soon, California, Miguel, Diego, and Morgan set out on an adventure that will turn their lives upside down. What they could never have imagined is that they are being followed by two funny thugs who are also after the mysterious woman.

name: In the Soop : Friendcation
summary: The continuation of the show "In the Soop" tells the story of the travels of Park Seo Joon, Pikboy, Choi Woo Shik, Park Hyun Shik and Wee from BTS, known to the public as WOOGA Squad. They are all best friends working in the entertainment industry who have been maintaining a friendship for 10 years. After Vi's unexpected proposal, they went on a friendly trip for 3 nights and 4 days.

name: Супер МЯУ
summary: Five cubs—Ali the lion cub, Niya the panther, Bao the tiger cub, Vasya the snow leopard, and his little sister Sonya—attend a school for superheroes. There, they learn to use their special abilities, as well as how to be brave, kind, and work together. Meanwhile, Arnold, a cunning fennec fox, wants to lure the talented students away to his own school for supervillains.

name: Пepвaя oтpицaтeльнaя
summary: Tough, independent policewoman Ulzhan and timid, traditional Kelinka Aisha end up in the hospital with severe injuries. Doctors connect the girls to a heart-lung machine, transfusing their blood to each other to save their lives. Waking up, Ulzhan and Aisha gradually notice that their habits and characters have changed. Now the girls have to adapt to reality and face the consequences of their changed characters.

name: Oswaldo
summary: Oswaldo was found at the beach when he was a tiny little face-melting adorable baby penguin. Adapted and raised by human parents, now he must face his biggest challenge—surviving school. Which is way harder than it sounds, especially when you are an excitable, flat-out weird little guy whose brain is infused with useless pop-culture. And sometimes the simplest problems have the most bizarre outcomes. So it's no wonder Oswaldo is not exactly the most popular kid around. Thankfully, this weirdest of penguins can count on Tobias and Leia as the perfect side-kicks. They are the kind of friends who are there no matter what life throws at him – strict art teachers, rabid packs of babies, role-playing games gone awry, and even occasional rogue science fair projects. Which is pretty much what Oswaldo would call a normal day.

name: Married at First Sight: Afterparty
summary: Married at First Sight: Afterparty is a talk show that airs following every new episode of "Married at First Sight" and is hosted by the incredibly talented, Emmy nominated, actor, host and MAFS fan, Keshia Knight Pulliam. Fresh off screening that night's episode, Keshia dishes with the MAFS current cast to get the inside scoop on the action, romance, and behind the scenes drama. Whether it's laughter, tears, conflict or exclamations of true love, there is never a dull moment!

name: Закрыть гештальт
summary: Miraculously surviving after falling from the 20th floor, the manager of the car dealership Fedor Yartsev acquires an unusual gift: now he sees ghosts. A vindictive mother—in-law and a school physical education teacher, a bandit from the nineties and an elderly intellectual - who just won't bother Fedor with their unfinished business. Even his own young father, who disappeared at the age of 20. The hero will unwittingly become an intermediary between the worlds and help the lost souls to go where they should. And at the same time to establish relations with the pope, whom he did not know before, and will close gestalts, the existence of which he did not even suspect.

name: Купцы и дети
summary: "Merchants and Children" is a story on the topical, regardless of time, topic of the relationship between fathers and children. The action takes place in Russia in 1910. The son returns to the house of the patriarchal and conservative merchant of the first guild after his studies. During his studies, thanks to new friends, his views have changed dramatically. However, this categorically does not suit the father, and he is determined to re-educate his son. Will he be able to get everything back on track?

name: А сейчас реклама!
summary: Christmas drama about advertisers "And now advertising!"

name: Трансформеры
summary:
Sasha is a simple man, with his wife and son, works as a police captain, but he has an addiction that he hides from everyone - at night he is Trixie Flowers, no one should know about it. His old dream came true, he got into one of the coolest Moscow travesty clubs in the main cast of the show.

Literally on the same day in the service, he learns that he will have to work with his partner in this club undercover to investigate the mysterious chain of poisoning of travesty with a new dangerous drug. The boss appoints Sasha to be a security guard, and his partner is a travesty. The partner gets depressed. Sasha decides to "save" his partner and infiltrate the club under the guise of travesty.

name: Город бесов
summary: This is a mystical comedy about the most secret service of Russia. At the junction of Europe and Asia there is another junction, the junction of two worlds, ours and the otherworldly. They protect people from invaders from the other world – the SPMS is a secret division of the migration service, a kind of "men in black" in the Urals.

name: Человек выходит на сцену
summary: Sasha works as an animator on a quest and wants to be a great artist. He goes to auditions, but they don't take him anywhere. At the same time, his father, a musician, takes young female fans home after concerts. One of them brings with her a 10-year-old sister who has no one to leave with. So Sasha meets a girl who suddenly becomes his friend and guide to the world of cinema.

name: Переговорщик
summary: Alexander Maksimov is a brilliant psychologist and the best negotiator in Russia. He has a huge experience and a large number of rescued people behind his back: he worked during terrorist attacks, persuaded hostages to be released, dissuaded criminals and victims from committing a fatal act. Over the years in the profession, Maximov has developed his own unique method of negotiating. But even a seemingly perfect employee makes mistakes. In the past, Maksimov, negotiating with terrorists who seized the school, is defeated — his daughter is killed. Unable to look into the eyes of his wife and son, Alexander leaves the family. Years later, the hero again encounters the culprit of that tragedy — it turns out that the attacker did not die during the explosion at that school and now throws Maximov a new challenge.

name: Друг на час
summary: Nikolai Sergeyevich, who has been leading the pediatrics department for many years, retires and enters the "wonderful world of pensioners". Unfortunately, Nikolai Sergeyich has neither savings nor a family. His wife left him a year ago, but left him touching letters with memories and advice for the rest of his life. Having quickly tasted all the public benefits of his position, Nikolai Sergeyevich decides to immediately go to his wife. He arranges a farewell dinner for himself, but then fate brings him together with a young energetic guy Lech, who works as a "friend for an hour", and together they go to breaking bad.

name: Под покровом ночи
summary: Armed only with her phone, the girl is trying to escape from a city engulfed by a zombie apocalypse.

name: Капельник
summary: Vanya is an anesthesiologist-resuscitator in an ordinary Moscow hospital, in his spare time he works as a "dropper" - illegally removes post-drug syndrome from stellar drug addicts and alcoholics.

name: Химера
summary: 2012. Drug lord Rahmon is trying to seize the market share of the Tatarintsev family, who control the supply of cocaine through the seaport of St. Petersburg. Major of drug control Konkov undertakes to unravel the criminal knot. At this time, the adapted autistic Juice begins to sell drugs in a new, safe way: without face-to-face contacts with customers, through the new Chimera website.

name: Кафе «Куба»
summary: The beginning of the noughties, a small village on the highway leading to Moscow. A colorful cafe "Cuba" is located here, and it is run by a strong and sharp-tongued Tamara.

name: Приход
summary: The young deacon Peter's father, the rector of the old church in the provincial Danilovo Posad, is dying. Unexpectedly, instead of Petya, Father Dmitry from Moscow is appointed the new rector. Petya does not trust the visiting priest and begins his investigation. which leads to a terrible discovery: Father Dmitry is a real devil, and he was in this parish for a reason. To protect his temple and the city, Petya enters into a battle with evil.

name: Морозко
summary: A lonely girl Rita finds out that she has the last egg left - the last chance to become a mother. Having no partner, she agrees to do IVF from an anonymous donor of TYPE-547, but at the last moment her embryo is stolen from the laboratory. Rita goes in search of an embryo, during which she learns the shocking truth about who is hiding under the name of SPECIES-547, recalls her childhood and finds out the real reasons for her loneliness.

name: Тётя Марта
summary: Marta leads an ordinary life – she looks after the house, takes care of her grandfather, goes shopping and beauty salons, studies and copes with various difficulties on her own. Everything would be fine, only she's only eight years old.

name: Разделенная семья
summary: "A Divided Family" is a tragicomedy about close people separated by a long distance.

name: Горемыки
summary: The comedy "The Wretches" by Nikita Tamarov is about how everyday conflicts between roommates can end with an alien invasion, rivalry with an ancient Egyptian god, flight into space, escape from the afterlife and even the arrest of the real Santa Claus.

name: Барабашка
summary: A comedy series with Anton Filipenko and Olga Dibtseva about a brownie who forces the owner of the apartment to unwittingly solve the accumulated problems. Artyom is quarantined at home alone and notices something strange: things are out of place, food disappears right from under his nose, and an indecent message appears on the refrigerator. Trying to understand the situation, the hero realizes that he has an invisible neighbor. While Artyom is fighting the hated lamb, relatives suspect him of insanity. Problems grow like a snowball, and Artyom needs to unravel this tangle of contradictions.

name: Anke
summary: A young talk show host tries to juggle her private life with her work, and make sense of everything.

previousepisode.name: Ghosts that Came from the Eastern Countries (Part Two)

name: White Lies
summary: When Seo Eun Young's fiance, Kang Jung Woo, leaves her alone and pregnant, she manages to get on with her life. Just as she has a chance to find happiness with Kang Hyung Woo, Jung Woo returns to complicate everything.

name: Secrets of the Lost Liners
summary: Secrets of the Lost Liners is an in-depth marine history series charting the design, service and loss of some of the world's greatest ocean liners. From art deco icons, luxury floating palaces, to national symbols, this six-part documentary covers 100 years of extravagant ships that pushed the boundaries of engineering and design, but which, one by one, were tragically lost through conflict, accident or human error. With unprecedented access to experts and historians, and never before seen footage, Secrets of the Lost Liners will uncover each ship's storied past. Episodes include the Cap Arcona, the Queen Elizabeth, SS Rex, the Andrea Doria, the Normandie, and SS America.

name: Wild Dogs: Running with the Pack
summary: Roam Zambia's South Luangwa National Park with Julz Braatvedt as he captures the triumphs and disasters of three wild dog packs during the dry season.

name: María Marta: El crimen del country
summary: The history of the crime of María Marta García Belsunce, which occurred on October 27, 2002 in Argentina.

name: Night of Love with You
summary:
Qiqi, a comic book character who played a minor role of a villain for many years, made a mistake when she entered the new comic "Night of Love" and turned from a supporting actress into the heroine Luo Qing.
In this story, the male character of the main character suddenly disappeared, and the male antagonist no longer has a love story, will Qi Qi find his happiness?

name: Doctor Cha Jung Sook
summary: It tells the story of a medical graduate turned housewife but decided to return to the medical field, and a doctor husband who maintains a perfect dual life. He is great at his job and he is also great at cheating on his wife.

name: Submersos
summary: Nando Oliveira is a former surfing world champion, who retired early, and is the illegitimate son of the favorite candidate for the state government of SC. Nando gets involved in a scheme which leads him into a wheel of corruption, betrayal and drugs between Brazil and Argentina, which puts his life at risk.

name: John Torode's Ireland
summary: Masterchef judge and Aussie chef John Torode visits the country of his ancestors and discovers a food scene undergoing a genuine renaissance. From the increasingly diverse cities of Dublin, Cork and Galway to the lush grasslands of its counties like Wicklow and Kerry to it's stunning coastline, John tastes and cooks his way through some of the best natural produce on earth. He meets an amazing array of Irish food champions from seaweed foragers to salmon smokers to bean to bar chocolate makers, enjoying sumptuous dishes in beautiful landscapes and the warmest hospitality and best craic in the world.

name: Mord in der Familie - Der Zauberwürfel
summary: Thomas Becker, son of a powerful building contractor, is shot on New Year's Day. Commissioner Barbara Falck and colleague Christian Krämer start the investigation and suspect a connection with the collapse of the "cube", in which a young cleaner was killed. Was the murder of Thomas an act of revenge against the Becker & Sons company?

name: Zeytin Ağacı
summary: Three friends arrive in a seaside town, where they connect with their spiritual selves and suddenly face unresolved trauma from their families' pasts. They will make peace with their past in order to make life changing decisions and eventually to create their own another-selves.

name: Капкан на судью
summary: Judge Nesterov is a principled and honest worker of the judicial system. Over the years of service, he was remembered for his loyalty to justice, his unique instinct for real criminals and his scrupulous study of evidence of the guilt of those convicted. On the day of his 55th anniversary, Nesterov's relatives, friends, colleagues and friends gather at his home. During the celebration, his daughter Anya mysteriously disappears. In a missing person situation, the first 48 hours are the most critical. The best police investigator, Major Zabelin, takes on the case of the disappearance of the daughter of a respected judge. During the investigative activities, the dark secrets of Judge Nesterov begin to emerge. The life of Nesterov's minor daughter now directly depends on whether the respected judge can admit to his professional mistake.

name: Под напряжением
summary:
Clinical psychologist Andrey Vysokov has a rare skill: he is able to literally "penetrate" an attacker's head and read the course of his thoughts and the logic of his actions. However, this ability prevents the hero from building normal relationships with people and makes him dependent on patients who are dangerous criminals and maniacs. 

Recently, together with investigator Irina Shumskaya, he has been investigating a series of murders that occurred in a small seaside town. This is not an ordinary case, and even an experienced Vysokov has to face incredible stress during the investigation.…

name: Dating with My Mates
summary:
Dating with My Mates follows a group of four single friends who go out for a three-course dinner with a difference.

With each course, a date joins the mates at their table. The drinks flow and the conversation sparkles, but when the plates are cleared, the date must leave. If the dates feel a connection, they can return at the end of the meal to ask out one of the mates. But the mates can only say yes to one date!

Will one friend be left on the shelf? Will the same friend get asked out by all three dates? Or will no one be asked out at all? Whatever the result, this is a love story with friendship at its heart.

name: Extreme Heights Repair Team
summary:
An exclusive peek into the high-octane world of rope access technicians.

When America's hardest to reach structures need repair, there are few people with the courage and expertise to handle the job. Enter elite rope access technician, Trask Bradbury.

This series follows Bradbury and his team as they cross the US to undertake nerve-shredding work on some of America's most impressive landmarks - everything from colossal dams and sweeping bridges to giant rollercoasters and towering statues. With just rope - and each other - for support, it's a remarkable world of bravery, skill and ingenuity that has rarely ever been documented.

name: The Captain
summary: He was the face of the New York Yankees, a five-time World Series champion, the most popular and admired player in baseball, and one of the great sports superstars of any age. The Captain tells the story of Derek Jeter's life and Hall of Fame career in a six-part docuseries that's anchored by exclusive, extensive, unprecedentedly candid interviews with Jeter, along with his family and dozens of teammates, rivals, and observers.

name: Días mejores
summary: Días mejores follows Sara, a mother who suddenly finds herself a widow and unable to comfort her troubled young son. She finds help with a therapy group of very distinct characters who are all struggling with similar personal tragedy, among them a down-and-out rock musician forced to take care of the teenage kids he long ago abandoned, a seemingly in-control chief exec desperately trying to keep up a facade, and a lonely young woman who wishes to have the child of her lost love.

name: Friendly Fire
summary: A group of friends that have remained very close since their school days. Though life has taken them down different paths, when they're brought back together, new confrontations and secrets arise, and a series of very surprising events unfold.

name: My Bossy Wife
summary: Lu Xiao Bai is a lazy young man who gets involved with Shen Jun Ye, a local constable. In desperation Lu Xiao Bai agreed to a contract marriage with Shen Jun Ye, became a son-in-law of the Shen family, and now lives with her in her family's residence. Their once hostile relationship soon grows into one of care and appreciation as they investigate a case together.

name: Strawberry Shortcake: Berry in the Big City
summary: A fresh new day, sweet dreams to chase, this berry is on a mission to bake the world a better place. It's Strawberry Shortcake. She'll make a difference, see it through, show the world what she can do. Get ready because she is back again! The fun adventures will never end in Big Apple City. She is making friends all over town, her smile is so bright everything is much more fun when she is around. She is the very best baker and a better friend to Orange Blossom, Blueberry Muffin, Lime Chiffon and Lemon Meringue. Welcome to the new world of Strawberry Shortcake: Berry in the Big City.

previousepisode.name: Bake the World a Better Place (2)

name: Miriam Margolyes: Australia Unmasked
summary: Miriam Margolyes is back on the road, heading west along the bottom of Australia, to understand what the Fair Go means in Australia today and how it is playing out in the diverse lives of her fellow citizens.

name: J Schwanke's Life in Bloom
summary: Host J Schwanke shows how to bring the beauty of flowers into your surroundings and demonstrates how living a life surrounded by colorful blossoms can reduce stress, instill wellness, and enhance happiness.

name: Hotties
summary: In this wild dating competition, 4 hot singles go on blind dates and battle to cook up date-night worthy dishes. But, in order to keep cooking, they'll have to choke down extreme spicy food challenges! Will beating the heat help them burn through first date facades to form a more authentic connection... or will it all just be a hilarious hot mess?

name: Royal Autopsy
summary:
Royal Autopsy investigates the cause of death of two of Britain's most famous monarchs: Queen Elizabeth I and King Charles II, in an entirely new and realistic way.

Professor Alice Roberts will bring together a blend of historical and medical expertise and by using contemporaneous accounts and documents piece together how and why these monarchs died.

Each investigation follows an autopsy conducted by Home Office pathologist Dr. Brett Lockyer which will use a unique combination of prosthetic bodies, actors, and ethically sourced animal organs to reveal how each of the monarchs perished.

name: Billionaire Blooms
summary:
Billionaire Blooms follows internationally renowned florists as they deliver awe inspiring displays for exclusive venues and the most discerning private clients.

The series is an insight into the unsung world of amazing design, meticulous planning and engineering of stunning floral installations on an epic scale, as cameras follow high end florists including the internationally renowned Jamie Aston as he plans and builds installations for his biggest gig of the year: a five-day wedding in Venice.

name: Ghosts of Devil's Perch
summary: Butte, Montana, is gripped by a terrifying supernatural uprising. To restore order, the mayor and sheriff enlist the help of paranormal investigators Dave Schrader, Cindy Kaza and K.D. Stafford to stop the wave of unnatural occurrences plaguing the historic mining town.

name: Scotland's Greatest Escape
summary:
Scotland's Greatest Escape takes audiences on a journey to the very best escapes that Scotland has to offer and ultimately crown one as Scotland's Greatest Escape. 

Across the series a wide variety of holiday styles and destinations available across Scotland will be showcased. With the emphasis on exceptionality and not luxury, all budgets will be catered for. From wellness retreats to adrenalin fuelled activity breaks, romantic getaways to family fun, each episode will showcase the top three destinations in their category and be road-tested by a family or group of friends with a passion for that particular holiday style. They will spend one night at each of the shortlisted destinations and be tasked to judge five specific elements of their stay. The holiday with the highest score goes forward to the grand final.

Once all finalists are selected, an industry panel, featuring some of Scotland's most experienced and renowned hospitality and tourism experts, will judge against strict industry standards. They will deliberate which of the finalists is most deserving of the award and present the title at the grand final which will be filmed at a prestigious Scottish location.

name: WNBA Commissioner's Cup
summary: The Commissioner's Cup presented by Coinbase is an annual in-season competition, which features 61 games this year, with a prize pool of $500,000 in the Championship Game for the players and at least $165,000 in charitable donations throughout this year's series. At the end of Commissioner's Cup play, the team with the highest winning percentage in each conference will face off in a Championship Game. New this year, the Championship Game will take place at the home venue of the team with the highest winning percentage in Commissioner's Cup play.

previousepisode.name: 2026 WNBA Commissioner's Cup: Las Vegas Aces at New York Liberty

name: Transformers: EarthSpark
summary: The civil war between the Autobots and the Decepticons has relocated to a planet far from Cybertron, Earth. There, a new breed of Transformers emerges, when a multicultural family adopts them, ensuring their survival and the ties they make to their lineage.

name: Toutes ces choses qu'on ne s'est pas dites
summary: As far back as Julia Saurel can remember, she's had a difficult relationship with her father. Three days before she is supposed to get married, she receives a phone call – just as she had predicted, her father will not be able to attend her wedding. For once, Julia has to admit he has a really good excuse – he just died. Julia cannot help seeing the tragi-comic side of the situation. Her nuptial dreams transform into funeral plans and even from the grave, it seems her father Michel has his own particularly effective way of disrupting his daughter's life. But the day after his funeral, Julia discovers that her father has one last surprise in store for her when a tall wooden crate is delivered to her home – inside it is a life-size android, a carbon copy of her father.

name: Immortal Samsara
summary: Yan Dan is the sole descendant of the ancient tribe the Four-Leaved Scorpion. Yan Dan's entire being is a treasure trove of medicines. She and twin sister Zhi Xi transformed into human form a century before while attending the Queen Mother's Feast, but Yan Dan faced the greatest trial of her life - the love trial. Falling in love with Lord Ying Yuan resulted in her wasting the following 800 years forgetting him. Such a high price to pay!

name: Evil Touch
summary: On the last leg of their journey from Rome to Armenia, a teacher and his students find themselves in the ancient village of Tanrim whose residents uphold the noble cause of preventing a powerful evil force from escaping into the world

name: Vilangu
summary: Paridhi, an honest cop, must race against time to solve a mysterious crime case that has baffled the police department.

previousepisode.name: The Last Piece of the Puzzle

name: Scrapyard Dynasty
summary:
Wheeler dealer Terry Walker owns and runs one of the most successful scrap yards in Britain – despite the colourful cast of characters he employs. But it's not just scrap metal that turns him a tidy profit. He sees opportunities to make money everywhere and is always on the look for a nice little earner – anything from a job-lot of pyjamas to hand sanitiser. After all, you have to speculate to accumulate. But life at the yard is tough, as Terry's staff struggle to meet his ambitious targets to go global. And to make matters worse he and his wife Lyndsay don't always see eye to eye…

Each week this series follows the adventures of Terry, his family and the cast of salespeople, mechanics, dropouts and spanner monkeys who work for him, as he battles to turn ‘muck into brass' from their Bolton scrapyard base.

name: Minute by Minute: Emergency
summary: Emergency services teams, witnesses and survivors break down the hours, minutes and seconds of the biggest and most tragic news events to impact Australians.

name: DI4RI
summary: First crushes, first kisses, fun with friends — and feuds with rivals. In the halls of Galileo Galilei Middle School, every day is full of surprises!

name: The Hillside Strangler: Devil in Disguise
summary: The docuseries offers a new, in-depth peek inside the minds of notorious serial killing cousins Kenneth Bianchi and Angelo Buono who allegedly impersonated off-duty police officers to lure unsuspecting victims to their deaths before leaving their bodies to be found on the hillsides of East Los Angeles during the 1970s.

name: Mafia Queens
summary: In the midst of the bachelor party of Eyal Malka, one of the largest crime families in Israel, assassins kill all the men and "soldiers" of the family, led by Jacob Malka, the father of the family. The women of the Malka family, who have lost their status and power all at once, are thrown into a new reality in which they must fight for their place in the male world of the temple only power. The series tells the story of the family wives who try to stand on their feet again and rehabilitate the family business taken from them, as well as avenge the deaths of their loved ones.

name: Бедный олигарх
summary: The oligarch Viktor lives a wonderful, rich life: he has a yacht, a private jet, real estate around the world, business in various fields. But one morning, black for Viktor, he wakes up poor: all accounts are blocked, real estate is arrested, consultants do not answer calls. Viktor is on the list of those who will not soon eat oysters in Monaco. At this difficult moment, only his valet Adam remains next to the impoverished oligarch, who will help Viktor survive. And for this you have to do a lot: turn an expensive car into a taxi and even decide on injuries in order to get insurance.

name: A Turma da Mônica - A Série
summary: The most beloved gang in comics and also in cinema comes to TV to live new adventures, based on the work of Mauricio de Sousa and adaptation by Vitor and Lu Cafaggi.

name: Tracker
summary: Tracker features lone-wolf survivalist Colter Shaw, who roams the country as a "reward seeker," using his expert tracking skills to help private citizens and law enforcement to solve all manner of mysteries while contending with his own fractured family.

name: 90 Day Fiancé UK
summary: Follow eight loved-up Brits and their long-distance lovers for 90 days to see if they commit or call the whole thing off! For these real life couples the stakes could not be higher - so much could go wrong, and so much could go right.

name: Modern Love Hyderabad
summary: 6 stories of love, growth, resilience and acceptance. Modern Love Hyderabad is an anthology series that is equal parts a study on modern relationships as it is a love letter to the deliciously diverse city of Hyderabad.

name: Tim Westwood
summary: BBC Three investigates the renowned rap DJ, hearing from six black women who accuse him of sexual misconduct, predatory sexual encounters and unwanted touching.

name: English Football League Highlights
summary: All the highlights, action and talking points from the latest English Football League matches.

name: Ludik
summary: The series revolves around Ludik, who appears to be a salt of the earth oke, styling himself as a wholesome family man running a successful furniture business. However, behind the veneer of respectability, Ludik is steeped in the underworld that sees him crossing paths with mobsters and murderers. With his family in turmoil, jail time on the horizon and death imminent, Ludik must rely on both his old and new allies to prevail and save his everything.

name: Cleaning Britain's Greatest Treasures
summary: The work of conservation cleaners looking after national treasures.

name: Cash in the Attic
summary: Collectibles are evaluated and sold to help raise money for special projects.

name: Keep This Between Us
summary: Keep This Between Us exposes an epidemic of widespread grooming — manipulative and coercive behavior by abusers to gain access to potential victims — in U.S. high schools. The series follows one woman's journey as she reexamines her past relationship with a trusted teacher.

name: No-Recipe Road Trip with the Try Guys
summary: With millions of followers and a loyal fanbase, comedy group The Try Guys, including Keith Habersberger, Ned Fulmer, Zach Kornfeld and Eugene Lee Yang, are well-known for their curiosity, humor and willingness to try anything under the sun, often with hilarious results.  The four fearless best friends and business partners also love food and trying to cook new dishes with zero instruction and in No-Recipe Road Trip with the Try Guys, they test their culinary instincts to recreate signature menu items in restaurants across the country – and the final dishes are all over the map.  In each episode, the guys hit a new city and visit two local establishments where each must attempt to make the restaurant's best-known dish with no recipe or instruction. In the end, the Try Guy with the most successful dish as determined by a local chef and guest judge wins and gets the chance to have their dish put on the restaurant's menu.

name: About Youth
summary: Ye Guang is an elite high school student and a popular campus idol, while Xu Qi Zhang is an exemplary guitarist who normally has a weak sense of existence but completely transforms himself when on stage. The two boys have completely different backgrounds and values but when they compete in the election battle for the throne of the student president, it seems there may be more attraction than animosity between the two.

name: Le maître du Jeu
summary: Taskmaster Louis Morissette and his assistant Antoine Vézina impose a series of playful challenges that test the creativity and ingenuity of a panel of five comedians.

name: The Doll Factory
summary: Set in London in 1850, The Doll Factory tells the story of Iris, who paints dolls for a living alongside her twin sister, Rose, and dreams of becoming an artist and by night secretly paints herself naked. Silas is a taxidermist who owns a shop filled with his creations. He dreams of one day finding an item so unique he will be catapulted to fame. Louis is a painter and member of the Pre-Raphaelite Brotherhood, searching for his next muse. When Iris meets Silas, and then Louis, she is offered an opportunity to escape and start a new life. To do so, she must abandon her sister, sacrifice her reputation, and launch herself into the unknown. But as Iris' world expands, a story of dark obsession begins to unfold.

name: Copenhagen Cowboy
summary: Copenhagen Cowboy is a thrill-inducing, neon-drenched noir series which follows enigmatic young heroine, Miu. After a lifetime of servitude and on the verge of a new beginning, she traverses the ominous landscape of Copenhagen's criminal netherworld. Searching for justice and enacting vengeance, she encounters her nemesis, Rakel, as they embark on an odyssey through the natural and the supernatural. The past ultimately transforms and defines their future, as the two women discover they are not alone, they are many.

name: Europas vergessene Diktaturen
summary: When you think of Europe and the dictatorship, the first thing that comes to mind is German National Socialism. But the continent has seen other coercive regimes come and go throughout its history, which are highlighted in this series.

name: Gang Wars. Sticky Feet
summary: The new season of the popular Go3 original series brings viewers the brutal underworld of Lithuania in the 1990s.

name: Cooper's Bar
summary: When Kris Latimer, the biggest dick in Hollywood, stumbles upon Cooper Marino's backyard tiki bar oasis, Cooper and his pals pull themselves together for one last shot at their "big break."

name: Reetur
summary: In 2004, just before Estonia became a NATO member, Russian intelligence services recruit Alfred Vint, an official at the Estonian Defense Ministry.

name: Tutto chiede salvezza
summary:
Does ending up under TSO (Compulsory Health Treatment) for seven days mean being crazy? This is what Daniele asks himself. Daniele is a twenty-year-old with a great sensitivity, who after a psychotic crisis wakes up in the dormitory of a psychiatric ward. There he finds himself with five unlikely roommates with whom he thinks he has nothing in common, pressured by doctors who they want to rummage in his brain, and looked after by nurses who seem cynical and disinterested. But seven days are long and what at first seemed like a sentence gradually turns into one of the most intense and formative experiences of his life.

Tutto chiede salvezza (Everything Calls for Salvation) is loosely based on the acclaimed novel of the same name by Daniele Mencarelli.

name: Paname Comedy Club
summary: It gives you an appointment for an hour of stand up with the best of the one man show of the comedians of the moment. They are funny, incisive, hilarious, fearsome or simply charming. The Paname Comedy Club is a guaranteed hour of laughter!

previousepisode.name: Louis Chappey, Ilyes Melan Natacha Gomez, Clémént K, Nacef l'handicapable, Dysket, Abder, Wita, PV, Ryad Graham, Elena Bentolila

name: Marianne s'en mêle
summary: With her exploded ideas and her colorful style, Marianne sets herself the challenge of transforming the rooms of teenagers who need a breath of fresh air. Its mission: to rearrange, adapt and improve the space according to the tastes and needs of its guest.

name: Chair Tendre
summary: After moving to a new city, Sasha starts at a new high school. Her mysterious and charismatic personality leaves a lasting impression everywhere she goes. Like any teenager, making new friends, flirting with boys, and arguing with her parents are part of her everyday life. But two weeks ago, people knew Sasha as a boy. As an intersex person, she's newly embracing her feminine side but feels the need to hide her differences from others.

name: Float
summary: Lifeguarding at the local pool, Jade and Collette begin an unexpected romance.

name: Esprit d'hiver
summary: On a snowy Christmas morning, Holly Judge awakens with the fragments of a nightmare floating on the edge of her consciousness. Something followed them from Russia. Thirteen years ago, she and her husband Eric adopted baby Tatty, their pretty, black-haired Rapunzel, from the Pokrovka Orphanage #2. Now, at fifteen, Tatiana is more beautiful than ever—and disturbingly erratic. Based on the novel by Laura Kasischke.

name: Mégantic
summary: Mégantic is inspired by the events that occurred during the Lac-Mégantic rail tragedy in 2013. This fiction follows the destinies of Méganticois marked by bereavement and trauma, but also by solidarity, courage and heroism.

name: Indéfendable
summary: Follow the world of Cabinet Lapointe-Macdonald and its criminal defense team; a realistic universe built of human dramas, from the smallest to the largest, all imbued with the same emotion: fear.

name: Тень, или Может быть, всё обойдётся
Secrets & Scandals
summary: The truth of what went on behind the scenes at some of the biggest tv shows.

previousepisode.name: Strictly Come Dancing: Secrets, Sex & Scandals

name: Морские дьяволы. Вектор атаки
summary: The enemies are still strong, smart, and often have personal scores with Batia, Bagira, Bison, Prigotov, and other fighters-the legendary "Sea Devils." This time, the Akula militant group is opposed by a satellite of the Western special services, the Bellona PMC, led by spy Irma Swanson and her deputy Kevin Maxwell. According to their leadership, they are the very "explosive mixture" that can destroy the squad and discredit the KTC. The Sharks, led by Batya and Bagira, find themselves at the forefront of an invisible front, constantly emerging from seemingly intractable situations as winners.

name: The Art of the Garden
summary: The very best of contemporary garden design around the world.

name: Killing Mum & Dad
summary: Crime documentary investigating cases of couples murdered by their own children.

name: Killer USA
summary:
Global production outfit FirstLook TV and True Crime Network have greenlit a new docuseries, Killer USA, based on the existing format Killer Britain, which airs on A+E's C+I service in the UK.

The 10-episode series will follow the format of the UK version, examining true stories of murder and deception that captured the public's imagination. Killer USA will be hosted by acclaimed TV journalist Brian Ross.

name: Killer Town
summary: Stories of big city crimes in small-town America. Uncovering the lives and circumstances of the victims while outlining and examining the convicted individual's motives.

name: Last of the Giants: Wild Fish
summary: Cyril Chauquet and his team are dropped into the middle of the wildest environments on the planet with the sole mission of collecting vital specimens that could save species from extinction.

name: Sky Sharks
summary: Using the very latest drones, we take to the skies to give SharkFest a fresh new perspective. With our "eyes in the sky" we will reveal amazing shark action like never before.

name: Purgatory
summary: A group of strangers are each invited to a remote winter resort for an exciting New Year's Eve celebration. They are soon trapped underground by one looking for revenge due to a death that ties each of them together.

name: Daredevil: Born Again
summary: Matt Murdock finds himself on a collision course with Wilson Fisk when their past identities begin to emerge.

name: La planète des Géants
summary:
More than 50 million years ago, the ancestors of the Whales and other Cetaceans returned to the ocean. This might seem like a backward step: how could a mammal breathe, give birth, suckle its young, sleep and feed underwater? Nonetheless, they succeeded in conquering the depths of the whole planet. To survive, they developed mysterious means of communication and new hunting techniques.

Whale song, tail-slapping by Sperm Whales, Dolphins whistling: what are these giants of the deep saying through these enigmatic sounds? How do the Orcas of the Valdes Peninsula learn to beach themselves to catch prey, the only Whales to have mastered this technique? Such behaviors remain fascinating mysteries, and our quest to unravel them takes us from Polynesia to Florida, from Mexico to Argentina.

Thanks to recent discoveries, and in the company of François Sarano, oceanographer and former companion of Jacques Cousteau, we discover these giants of the oceans and the secrets to their survival.

name: The Eminence in Shadow
summary: Shadowbrokers are those who go unnoticed, posing as unremarkable people, when in truth, they control everything from behind the scenes. Sid wants to be someone just like that more than anything, and something as insignificant as boring reality isn't going to get in his way! He trains in secret every single night, preparing for his eventual rise to power—only to denied his destiny by a run-of-the-mill (yet deadly) traffic accident. But when he wakes up in a another world and suddenly finds himself at the head of an actual secret organization doing battle with evil in the shadows, he'll finally get a chance to act out all of his delusional fantasies!

name: Reincarnated as a Sword
summary: Reincarnated as a sentient weapon with memories of his past life, but not his name, a magical sword saves a young beastgirl from a life of slavery. Fran, the cat-eared girl, becomes his wielder, and wants only to grow stronger, while the sword wants to know why he is here. Together, the strange duo's journey has only just begun!

nextepisode.name: Jean du Vix Knows His Stuff

name: Geomeun Yang Geim
summary: Over the next four days and three nights, in a secluded area, players must uncover each other's secret identities. They play on either team - the Mafia or the Citizens. A select few with life experience play for the Mafia, while the majority represent the Citizens. Through a series of intense missions, players must determine who is who, relying on mere intuition. The player with the sharpest intuition who can deduce everyone's true self wins the prize money.

name: Daily Dose of Sunshine
summary: Heartwarming drama about a caring young nurse navigates the complex world of mental health and the diverse stories of her patients.

name: Mein Job – Dein Job
summary: Employees from Bavaria swap places with employees from other countries around the globe and learn a lot about the economy and customs in the culture of "the other".

name: Legends of Spark
summary: Spark, the repair car, and his team train hard to achieve their goals and beat their enemies along the way. Will Spark succeed in becoming a racing driver?

name: Mumindalen
summary: Here we get to meet all the familiar characters from Moomin Valley - Moomindad, Moominmamma, Filjfonkan, Too-tick, Snusmumriken, Hemulen, Snorkfröken and of course the Moomintroll herself. For a whole year, we get to follow life in Moomindalen. It all starts when the Moomintroll, who is supposed to be sleeping this year, wakes up from his winter sleep and sets out on a journey of discovery.

name: Justice Served
summary: A band of freedom fighters invade the trial of a white police officer who shot a Black man - and a hostage situation unfolds on screens nationwide.

name: Pacto Brutal: O Assassinato de Daniella Perez
summary: In 1992, 22-year-old rising telenovela star Daniella Perez, dubbed "Brazil's Sweetheart," went missing after a day on set, prompting a desperate search throughout Rio de Janeiro. After locating the actress' body, police zero in on her co-star Guilherme de Pádua, whose unhealthy obsession with Perez quickly sparks an international media frenzy. As bizarre and alarming details emerge, Daniella's mother, screenwriter Glória Perez, begins a decades-long fight for justice – not only for her own daughter, but for all victims of violent crime.

name: 35 Serial Killers the World Wants to Forget
summary: Experience astonishing stories from people whose lives were touched in some way by a serial killer. This series investigates why the crimes happened, and what effect they had on those who knew the murderers.

name: The Killing
summary: Police Captain Hisham begins his investigation into the murder of an influencer found dead in the car of a national club electoral candidate.
